summaryBox.title: Quick Section Summary
summaryBox.takeaway: IUDs are inserted into the uterine cavity by medical doctors. Three major categories: (1) Non-Medicated: Lippes Loop (attracts macrophages, increases sperm phagocytosis), (2) Copper-Releasing: CuT, Cu7, Multiload 375 (releases Cu2+ to suppress sperm motility, acrosome enzymes, and viability), and (3) Hormone-Releasing: Progestasert, LNG-20 (renders endometrium unsuitable for implantation and thickens cervical mucus).

conceptBreakdown.content:
Intrauterine Devices (IUDs) are one of the most widely accepted and popular reversible contraceptive methods in India for spacing pregnancies.

### 4.1 Taxonomy of Intrauterine Devices
1. **Non-Medicated IUDs**:
   - *Example*: **Lippes Loop** (double-S shaped non-absorbable polyethylene loop impregnated with barium sulfate for X-ray visualization).
   - *Mechanism*: Induces a sterile, localized foreign-body inflammatory reaction in the endometrium, attracting macrophages and polymorphonuclear leukocytes that actively phagocytose incoming spermatozoa.
2. **Copper-Releasing IUDs**:
   - *Examples*: **CuT, Cu7, Multiload 375** (plastic frame wound with copper wire).
   - *Mechanism*: Continuously releases $\text{Cu}^{2+}$ ions into the uterine secretions.
3. **Hormone-Releasing IUDs**:
   - *Examples*: **Progestasert, LNG-20** (contains a reservoir of Levonorgestrel).
   - *Mechanism*: Continuously releases low doses of progestogen locally into the endometrium.

### 4.2 Biochemical Mode of Action of Copper-Releasing IUDs

```
                     MECHANISM OF COPPER-RELEASING IUDs
                     
   IUD releases Cu2+ ions into uterine cavity ──► Suppresses Sperm Motility & Viability
                                                       │
   Inhibits Acrosomal Enzymes ◄── Induces Foreign-Body Inflammation (Macrophage Phagocytosis)
```

- **Biochemical Effects of $\text{Cu}^{2+}$**:
  - Inhibits sperm glycolytic enzymes, starving spermatozoa of ATP.
  - Binds and inactivates acrosomal enzymes (Hyaluronidase and Acrosin), preventing penetration of the corona radiata and Zona Pellucida.
  - Suppresses flagellar beat frequency, reducing sperm progressive forward motility.

conceptBreakdown.heading: Hormone-Releasing IUD Endometrial Desynchronization
conceptBreakdown.title: Hormone-Releasing IUD Endometrial Desynchronization
conceptBreakdown.content: LNG-20 secretes 20 micrograms of levonorgestrel per day, suppressing endometrial gland growth (decidual atrophy) and desynchronizing endometrial maturation from ovulation, preventing blastocyst implantation.

conceptBreakdown.heading: Emergency Post-Coital IUD Insertion
conceptBreakdown.title: Emergency Post-Coital IUD Insertion
conceptBreakdown.content: Insertion of a Copper-IUD within 5 days (120 hours) of unprotected intercourse acts as the most effective emergency post-coital contraceptive with >99% efficacy.
